scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.tugboat.config.ts
scripts.build:release: node scripts/remap-paths.mjs node scripts/build-cli.mjs --release && node scripts/remap-paths.mjs tauri build
scripts.check: npm run build:tugboat && vue-tsc --noEmit && vitest run --dir src && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace
